description_full: Vestas Wind Systems A/S engages in the design, manufacture, installation, and services of wind turbines the United States, Denmark, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Power Solutions and Service. The Power Solutions segment offers onshore and offshore wind power plants, wind turbines, development sites, etc. The Service segment engages in the sale of service contracts, spare parts, and related activities. Vestas Wind Systems A/S was founded in 1898 and is headquartered in Aarhus, Denmark.

financial_summary: Vestas Wind Systems A/S is a large-cap industrials business with a $29.7B market cap on $21.0B of annual revenue.

The top line has compounded at +12% over the past three years, a respectable pace for a business of this size. Operating margins are expanding by +4.5pp year-over-year, which is one of the strongest signals that the moat is deepening.

Returns on capital run at 10% against a 9% cost of capital, which means the business barely earns its keep economically, and 10% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.

The business throws off $1.1B in free cash flow — roughly 5 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 2.94× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year, and interest coverage runs at 7.4×.
Shareholder yield is only 1.3%, a thin return of capital, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome.
